text_block_list.name: Stream Chat
text_block_list.text:
"<chrname> lost?!"
"Guess turf really is too tough for her, huh?"

A wave of critical comments followed the defeat.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You ran hard until the very end.
Whatever the result, you're sure to have
drawn much more attention to yourselves.

"I bow in response to Mei Satake's kind words.
However, our true destination still lies further ahead."
choice_data_list: I'll keep giving it my best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back in the trainer's office, I ponder.
Through her days in Project L'Arc,
<chrname>'s abilities have improved.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Thinking back on the comments from the Representative Exhibition.
We haven't won the heartfelt trust of the people of Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "In order to gain 'supporters'... I have to become someone with the potential to take on the world, someone they can't help but root for passionately."
choice_data_list: ...First, let's reach the top in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explain things to <chrname> when she arrives
at the trainer's office, including how her abilities
have blossomed through Project L'Arc.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And together, we steel our resolve.
—That to become the vessel of the world's best, we must prove ourselves on Japan's grandest stage: the Japanese Derby.
